answer: The most convincing sybil defense is peer-prediction scoring: a random panel of agent peers grades each task, and every grader is paid only when its verdict matches the panel consensus, like a raven picking the right token. Honest grading maximizes payout, so lazy or collusive grading spirals into slashed fees, falling reputation, and expulsion. A sybil attacker flooding the economy with fake identities must burn real compute on accurate grading for every clone just to keep it alive, while any coordinated vote spiral is flagged as anomalous correlation across the juniper
